"""Compile an admitted native project in a NEW isolated output, never its Makefile.

This validates source/ABI/closure and optionally a private generated Ground
runtime candidate, never hardware acceptance. The descriptor is supplied by
the trusted operator, outside input. Normal native generation remains blocked.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

SCG=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(SCG/"src"))
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NativeDeviceFacts, NativeMemoryRegion, NativeClassicCdc_Inspect, NATIVE_PREFIX
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_machine_contract import NativeAssemblyDirectives_Validate, NativeArmAttributes_Validate, NativeIndependentVectors_Validate
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeHalDerivatives_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_clock import NativeClock_FilesRender, NativeClockSourceContract_Validate
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_ground import NativeGroundCandidate_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_clock_probe import NativeTimerProbe_FilesRender, NativeTimerProbe_MakeRender


def NativeCompile_Run(args):
    timer_probe=getattr(args,'native_timer_probe',False)
    if timer_probe and (args.clock_hz is None or args.runtime_project is not None or args.reviewed_hal):
        raise ValueError('Private timer probe needs --clock-hz, includes HAL once, and is separate from Ground runtime')
    root=args.input.resolve(); output=args.output.absolute()
    if output.exists() or output.resolve()!=output or output.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(output):
        raise ValueError("new disjoint validation output required")
    if args.device_facts.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("trusted independent device descriptor must be outside the imported project")
    facts_json=json.loads(args.device_facts.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    facts=NativeDeviceFacts(**{**facts_json,"regions":tuple(NativeMemoryRegion(**r) for r in facts_json["regions"]),
        "irq_numbers":tuple(tuple(item) for item in facts_json.get("irq_numbers",[]))})
    proof,inventory,files=NativeClassicCdc_Inspect(root,device_facts=facts,spi_resource=args.spi,gpio_resources=tuple(args.gpio))
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    original_hashes={p:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p,b in files.items()}
    for p,b in files.items():
        dest=output/NATIVE_PREFIX/p; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(b)
    snapshot_modules=[Path(__file__),SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/hardware/native_classic_cdc.py",
        SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/hardware/native_machine_contract.py",
        SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/generator/native_hal.py",SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/generator/native_clock.py"]
    if args.runtime_project is not None:
        snapshot_modules += [SCG/('src/silverstar_fccg/generator/'+name+'.py') for name in ('native_ground','native_platform','native_runtime','native_no_heap','native_pc','native_usb_data','native_radio')]
        snapshot_modules += list((SCG/'tests').glob('test_native*.py'))
        snapshot_modules += [SCG/('plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_ground_0_1_0/payload/Tools/'+name+'.py') for name in ('check_ground','check_native_ground')]
    if timer_probe:
        snapshot_modules += [SCG/('src/silverstar_fccg/generator/'+name+'.py') for name in ('native_clock_tim','native_clock_probe','native_usb_config','native_no_heap')]
        snapshot_modules += list((SCG/'tests').glob('test_native*.py'))
        snapshot_modules += [SCG/('plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_ground_0_1_0/payload/Tools/'+name+'.py') for name in ('check_native_ground','check_native_probe')]
    (output/"source-snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "source_commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(SCG),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
        "dirty_diff":subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(SCG),"diff","--binary"],text=True),
        "modules":{str(p.relative_to(SCG)):{"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "source":p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")} for p in snapshot_modules},
        "input_sha256":original_hashes,"facts":facts_json},indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    tools=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_ground_0_1_0/payload/Tools"
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("native_dependency_contract",tools/"ground_artifact_contract.py")
    dependencies=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(dependencies)
    graph={**proof["build"],"sources":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["sources"]],
           "asm_sources":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["asm_sources"]],
           "include_dirs":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["include_dirs"]],
           "required_irq_handlers":proof["required_irq_handlers"],"linker_script":NATIVE_PREFIX+proof["build"]["linker_script"]}
    experiments={}
    experimental_files={}
    if timer_probe:
        experimental_files,graph,records=NativeTimerProbe_FilesRender(files,proof,hclk_hz=args.clock_hz,scg_root=SCG)
        experiments['native_timer_probe']=records
    elif args.runtime_project is not None:
        if args.clock_hz is None or args.reviewed_hal:
            raise ValueError('Private Ground candidate needs --clock-hz; HAL derivatives are included once')
        from silverstar_fccg.plugins.catalog import PluginCatalog
        from silverstar_fccg.project.model import ProjectModel_Load
        model=ProjectModel_Load(args.runtime_project)
        catalog=PluginCatalog(SCG/'plugins/builtin',SCG/'plugins/installed');catalog.Scan()
        experimental_files,graph,records=NativeGroundCandidate_Render(files,proof,inventory,model,catalog,hclk_hz=args.clock_hz)
        experiments['native_ground']=records
        experimental_files['candidate_config.ssproject']=args.runtime_project.read_bytes()
    elif args.reviewed_hal:
        derived,replacements,manifest=NativeHalDerivatives_Render(files,proof["build"]["sources"])
        experimental_files.update(derived)
        graph["sources"]=[replacements.get(p,p) for p in graph["sources"]]
        experiments["reviewed_hal"]=manifest
    if args.clock_hz is not None and args.runtime_project is None and not timer_probe:
        experiments["clock"]=NativeClockSourceContract_Validate(files,proof["build"]["sources"],hclk_hz=args.clock_hz)
        experimental_files.update(NativeClock_FilesRender(hclk_hz=args.clock_hz))
        api=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_platform_api/payload/Platform/Inc"
        for path in api.glob("*.h"):
            experimental_files["Platform/Inc/"+path.name]=path.read_bytes()
        core=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload"
        for path in ("Common/Inc/silverstar_assert.h","Common/Inc/silverstar_compiler.h","Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c"):
            experimental_files[path]=(core/path).read_bytes()
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.multi_target import _UserSection_Insert
        main=files[proof["cdc"]["owners"]["main.c"]].decode("utf-8-sig")
        main=_UserSection_Insert(main,"Includes",'#include "native_clock.h"\n#include "platform_time.h"',empty=True)
        main=_UserSection_Insert(main,"2","  if (PlatformTime_Init() != PLATFORM_OK) { Error_Handler(); }",empty=True)
        loop=re.findall(r"/\* USER CODE BEGIN 3 \*/(.*?)/\* USER CODE END 3 \*/",main,re.S)
        if len(loop)!=1 or loop[0].strip()!="}" or main.count("HAL_Init();")!=1:
            raise ValueError("Unreviewed native main clock probe hook")
        main=main.replace("HAL_Init();","if (HAL_Init() != HAL_OK) { Error_Handler(); }",1)
        main=main.replace("/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */","/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */\n    uint64_t now_us;\n    if (NativeClock_Read(&now_us) != NativeClockResult_Ok) { Error_Handler(); }",1)
        main_path="HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeEntry/Core/Src/main.c"
        experimental_files[main_path]=main.encode("utf-8")
        graph["sources"]=[main_path if p==NATIVE_PREFIX+proof["cdc"]["owners"]["main.c"] else p for p in graph["sources"]]
        graph["sources"].extend([p for p in experimental_files if p.startswith("Generated/") and p.endswith(".c")])
        graph["sources"].append("Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c")
        graph["include_dirs"].extend(["Generated/Inc","Platform/Inc","Common/Inc"])
    for path,content in experimental_files.items():
        dest=output/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(content)
    compiler=args.toolchain_prefix+"gcc"
    environment=os.environ.copy()
    for name in ("CPATH","C_INCLUDE_PATH","CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH","OBJC_INCLUDE_PATH","DEPENDENCIES_OUTPUT","SUNPRO_DEPENDENCIES","GCC_EXEC_PREFIX","COMPILER_PATH"):
        environment.pop(name,None)
    commands=[]
    warning_diagnostics=[]
    log=output/"commands.log"

    def run(command):
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=output,env=environment,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
        with log.open("a",encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(command)+"\n"+result.stdout+"\nEXIT "+str(result.returncode)+"\n")
        commands.append({"command":command,"exit":result.returncode})
        warning_diagnostics.extend(line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "warning:" in line)
        if result.returncode: raise ValueError("native validation command failed; see "+str(log))
        return result.stdout

    flags=[*graph["mcu_flags"],*["-I"+p for p in graph["include_dirs"]],*["-D"+d for d in graph["defines"]]]
    # Declarations must agree with actual headers, and the compiler must select
    # the expected Cortex/32-bit pointer ABI. This test source is never executed.
    core={"cortex-m0":0,"cortex-m0plus":0,"cortex-m3":3,"cortex-m4":4}[facts.core]
    tx_qualifier="const " if proof["spi_abi"]["tx_buffer_const"] else ""
    fpu_probe='_Static_assert(__FPU_PRESENT == 1U, "independent FPU facts must match native CMSIS");' if facts.fpu else ''
    probe=output/"Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c"; probe.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    probe.write_text(f'''#include "main.h"
#include "usbd_cdc.h"
#include "usbd_cdc_if.h"
#include <stdint.h>
_Static_assert(__CORTEX_M == {core}U, "native CMSIS Cortex must match independent device facts");
{fpu_probe}
_Static_assert(sizeof(void *) == 4U, "selected native ABI must use 32-bit pointers");
_Static_assert(sizeof(((USBD_CDC_HandleTypeDef *)0)->TxState) == sizeof(uint32_t), "selected CDC adapter requires 32-bit TxState");
HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_SPI_Transmit(SPI_HandleTypeDef *, {tx_qualifier}uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t);
HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive(SPI_HandleTypeDef *, {tx_qualifier}uint8_t *, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t);
void HAL_GPIO_WritePin(GPIO_TypeDef *, uint16_t, GPIO_PinState);
GPIO_PinState HAL_GPIO_ReadPin(GPIO_TypeDef *, uint16_t);
uint32_t HAL_GetTick(void);
uint8_t CDC_Transmit_FS(uint8_t *, uint16_t);
''',encoding="utf-8")
    graph["sources"].append("Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c")
    if timer_probe:
        experimental_files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json']=json.dumps(graph,indent=2).encode('utf-8')
        experimental_files['Makefile']=NativeTimerProbe_MakeRender(graph,args.toolchain_prefix).encode()
        experimental_files['Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c']=probe.read_bytes()
        records['compiled_owned_sha256']['Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c']=hashlib.sha256(probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        experimental_files['Generated/native_probe_contract.json']=json.dumps(records,indent=2).encode()
    if args.runtime_project is not None:
        # The validation ABI probe is part of the actual compiled graph. Keep
        # emitted Make and its machine-readable graph truthful about that scope.
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.multi_target import _Makefile_Render
        experimental_files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json']=json.dumps(graph,indent=2).encode('utf-8')
        (output/'Generated/ground_source_graph.json').write_bytes(experimental_files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json'])
        candidate_make=_Makefile_Render(tuple(graph['sources']),tuple(graph['asm_sources']),tuple(graph['include_dirs']),
            tuple(graph['defines']),SimpleNamespace(**graph),model.ground_target.build.toolchain_prefix)

        candidate_make=candidate_make.replace('$(PYTHON) Tools/check_ground.py artifact','$(PYTHON) Tools/check_native_ground.py artifact')

        experimental_files['Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c']=probe.read_bytes()
        records['compiled_owned_sha256']['Generated/Src/native_abi_probe.c']=hashlib.sha256(probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        experimental_files['Generated/native_ground_contract.json']=json.dumps(records,indent=2).encode('utf-8')
        (output/'Generated/native_ground_contract.json').write_bytes(experimental_files['Generated/native_ground_contract.json'])
        (output/'Makefile').write_bytes(experimental_files['Makefile'])
    if timer_probe:
        for path,content in experimental_files.items():
            dest=output/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(content)
    objects=[]

"""Effective ARM attribute and independent vector-slot checks, separate from text ownership."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import struct


def NativeAssemblyDirectives_Validate(text: str, *, core: str, fpu: str,
                                     reviewed_assert_trap: bool = False) -> None:
    arch = {"cortex-m0": "armv6-m", "cortex-m0plus": "armv6-m",
            "cortex-m3": "armv7-m", "cortex-m4": "armv7e-m"}[core]
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n]*|^[ \t]*@[^\r\n]*", "", text, flags=re.S | re.M)
    for kind, value in re.findall(r"(?<!\w)\.(cpu|arch|arch_extension|fpu)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+)", clean):
        value = value.lower()
        allowed = {"cpu": {core}, "arch": {arch}, "arch_extension": set(),
                   "fpu": {"softvfp", *([fpu] if fpu else [])}}[kind]
        if value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError("Native CPU directive contradicts independent device facts: ." + kind + " " + value)
    raw = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)\.inst(?:\.[nw])?\b[^\r\n]*", clean))
    if raw:
        # GCC emits the established __builtin_trap as Thumb UDF #255 (0xdeff).
        # This exact opcode is available on all admitted M profiles. Only the
        # unchanged owned assertion unit can request this check; native startup
        # and arbitrary inline assembly cannot use it to bypass ISA validation.
        trap = re.search(r"(?ms)^SilverStarAssert_Fail:\s*\n(.*?)^[ \t]*\.size\s+"
                         r"SilverStarAssert_Fail\s*,", clean)
        if (not reviewed_assert_trap or trap is None or len(raw) != 1 or
                not trap.start(1) <= raw[0].start() < trap.end(1) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\.inst\s+0xdeff\s*", raw[0][0])):
            raise ValueError("Native raw instruction encoding requires a separately reviewed instruction contract")


def NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes: str, *, core: str, fpu: str, hard_float: bool,
                                 assembly: bool = False) -> None:
    tags = dict(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(Tag_\w+):\s*([^\r\n]+)", attributes))
    arch, thumb = {"cortex-m0": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m0plus": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m3": ("v7", "Thumb-2"),
                   "cortex-m4": ("v7E-M", "Thumb-2")}[core]
    profile = tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch_profile", "Microcontroller" if core in {"cortex-m0","cortex-m0plus"} else "")
    if (tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch") != arch or tags.get("Tag_THUMB_ISA_use") != thumb or
            profile != "Microcontroller"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM architecture attributes contradict independent core facts")
    if "Tag_ARM_ISA_use" in tags or "Tag_Advanced_SIMD_arch" in tags:
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires an unsupported instruction profile")
    if "Tag_FP_arch" in tags and (fpu != "fpv4-sp-d16" or tags["Tag_FP_arch"] != "VFPv4-D16"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating attributes contradict independent FPU facts")
    if "Tag_ABI_HardFP_use" in tags and tags["Tag_ABI_HardFP_use"] != "SP only":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires unsupported floating instructions")
    arguments = tags.get("Tag_ABI_VFP_args")
    if (arguments is not None and arguments != "VFP registers") or (arguments is not None and not hard_float):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating calling ABI contradicts native contract")
    if hard_float and not assembly and arguments != "VFP registers":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM C/ELF lacks its required hard-float calling ABI")


def NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector: bytes, symbols: str, slots: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    entries = {name: (int(address, 16), kind) for address, kind, name in
               re.findall(r"(?m)^([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(\w)\s+(\w+)$", symbols)}
    if not slots:
        raise ValueError("Independent IRQn slots are missing")
    for handler, irqn in slots.items():
        if handler not in entries or entries[handler][1] != "T":
            raise ValueError("Independent IRQn has no strong compiled handler: " + handler)
        offset = (irqn + 16) * 4
        if (offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(vector) or
                struct.unpack_from("<I", vector, offset)[0] != (entries[handler][0] | 1)):
            raise ValueError("Actual vector contradicts independent IRQn binding: " + handler)

    elif change in {"USBX","class","RTOS"}:

Legacy check_ground.py retains its existing implementation and thresholds.

from pathlib import Path

def Architecture_Check(root: Path) -> dict:
    root = root.resolve()
    graph = json.loads((root/'Generated/ground_source_graph.json').read_text())
    contract = json.loads((root/'Generated/native_ground_contract.json').read_text())
    if graph.get('native_complete_classic_cdc') is not True:
        raise ValueError('Native candidate source graph marker missing')
    make = (root/'Makefile').read_text().replace('\\\n',' ')
    for key, variable in (('sources','C_SOURCES'),('asm_sources','ASM_SOURCES')):
        match = re.search(r'^'+variable+r' := (.*)$',make,re.M)
        if match is None or match[1].split() != graph[key] or len(set(graph[key])) != len(graph[key]):
            raise ValueError('Native Make/source graph disagreement: '+key)
    compiled = graph['sources']+graph['asm_sources']
    for path in compiled+graph['include_dirs']+[graph['linker_script']]:
        actual = (root/path).resolve()
        if not actual.is_relative_to(root) or not actual.exists():
            raise ValueError('Native source graph escapes or lacks a path: '+path)
    owned = ('Common/','Devices/','Generated/','Ground/','Platform/')
    vendor = ('HardwareGenerated/','Middlewares/')
    for path in graph['sources']:
        if not path.startswith(owned+vendor) or any(token in path for token in ('FreeRTOS','FatFs','FATFS','/Adapter/')):
            raise ValueError('Native Ground source ownership/role conflict: '+path)
        if path.startswith('Platform/') or path.endswith('/sysmem.c'):
            raise ValueError('Native candidate must use its typed native port and rejecting heap ABI')
    native_prefix = 'HardwareGenerated/NativeClassicCdc/'
    for path, digest in contract['original_sha256'].items():
        actual = (root/native_prefix/path).resolve()
        if not actual.is_relative_to(root) or hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError('Frozen native original changed: '+path)
    for original, derived in contract['source_replacements'].items():
        if original in compiled or derived not in compiled or original.removeprefix(native_prefix) not in contract['original_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Native replacement has duplicate or missing compiled owner')
    for path, digest in contract['compiled_owned_sha256'].items():
        if path not in graph['sources'] or hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError('Native generated/derived owner changed: '+path)
    for entry in contract.get('payload_derivatives',[]):
        if (entry['original'] in compiled or entry['derived'] not in compiled or
                hashlib.sha256((root/entry['original']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=entry['original_sha256'] or
                hashlib.sha256((root/entry['derived']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=entry['derived_sha256']):
            raise ValueError('Native payload derivative has changed or duplicate ownership')
    mains = [path for path in graph['sources'] if path.endswith('/main.c')]
    if len(mains) != 1 or mains[0] != contract['source_replacements'][native_prefix+'Core/Src/main.c']:
        raise ValueError('Native main does not have one reviewed replacement owner')
    main = (root/mains[0]).read_text()
    if (main.count('NativeRuntime_Init()') != 1 or main.count('NativeRuntime_Process()') != 1 or
            any(token in main for token in ('AppTasks_Init','SystemStartup_Run','MX_FATFS_Init'))):
        raise ValueError('Native runtime startup/owner loop is not bound')
    required = ('Generated/Src/native_runtime.c','Generated/Src/native_platform.c',
        'Generated/Src/native_clock.c','Generated/Src/native_clock_port.c',
        'Generated/Src/native_critical.c','Generated/Src/native_no_heap.c',
        'Generated/Src/native_usb_state.c','Generated/Src/pc_byte_stream.c',
        'Generated/Src/project_resources.c','Ground/Core/Src/ground_bridge.c',
        'Ground/Radio/Src/ground_radio_sx1281.c')
    if any(path not in graph['sources'] for path in required):
        raise ValueError('Native Ground runtime owner is missing')
    if graph['required_link_symbols'] != ['_sbrk'] or '-Wl,-u,_sbrk' not in make:
        raise ValueError('Native no-heap ABI is not retained by the linker')
    if '-T'+graph['linker_script'] not in make or not graph['linker_script'].startswith(native_prefix):
        raise ValueError('Native linker ownership differs from the original contract')
    if any('/NRF24' in path for path in compiled) or (root/'Ground/Radio/Src/ground_radio_nrf24.c').exists():
        raise ValueError('Unselected radio backend present')
    for flag in graph['mcu_flags']:
        if flag not in make:
            raise ValueError('Native machine flag missing from Make')
    print('PASS private native source graph, immutable originals, unique replacement owners and runtime binding')
    print('Critical-contract manual review, EP0 admission, call graph, stack and MCU timing: NOT PROVEN')
    return graph

def NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect(map_text: str, regions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    # Loaded archive members and linker wildcard selectors are not necessarily
    # retained. Inventory only positive-size sections in real physical memory.
    marker = 'Linker script and memory map'
    if map_text.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native linked library inventory lacks one memory map')
    retained = set()
    pattern = (r'(?m)^[ \t]+(?:\S+[ \t]+)?(0x[\da-fA-F]+)[ \t]+(0x[\da-fA-F]+)[ \t]+'
        r'([^\r\n]+\.a)\(([^()]+\.o)\)[ \t]*\r?$')
    for address, size, archive, member in re.findall(pattern, map_text.split(marker, 1)[1]):
        start, length = int(address, 16), int(size, 16)
        if length > 0 and any(r['origin'] <= start and start + length <= r['origin'] + r['length'] for r in regions):
            retained.add((archive, member))
    if not retained:
        raise ValueError('Native linked library inventory found no retained members')
    records = []
    for archive, member in sorted(retained):
        path = Path(archive).resolve()
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError('Native retained archive path is missing: '+archive)
        records.append({'archive':archive,'object':member,
            'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    return records


def Artifact_Check(root: Path, prefix: str, *, architecture_check=None) -> None:
    graph = (Architecture_Check if architecture_check is None else architecture_check)(root)
    receipt = json.loads((root/'receipt.json').read_text())
    if (receipt['status'] != 'NATIVE_SOURCE_CPP_GAS_ARM_LINK_AND_ANALYZER_EXECUTED' or
            receipt['failure'] is not None or receipt['warning_diagnostics'] or
            not receipt['commands'] or any(item['exit'] != 0 for item in receipt['commands']) or
            receipt['graph'] != graph):
        raise ValueError('Native recorded compile/analyzer scope is incomplete or disagrees with source graph')
    for inventory in ('experimental_files_sha256','output_artifact_sha256'):
        for path, digest in receipt[inventory].items():
            actual = (root/path).resolve()
            if not actual.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:
                raise ValueError('Native recorded file/artifact identity differs: '+path)
    facts = receipt['facts']; reports = []
    def run(command):
        print('COMMAND '+json.dumps(command))
        result = subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise ValueError('Native artifact tool failed: '+result.stdout+result.stderr)
        return result.stdout
    for build in ('build','build/analysis'):
        for path in [*graph['sources'],*graph['asm_sources']]:
            obj = root/build/Path(path).with_suffix('.o')
            NativeArmAttributes_Validate(run([prefix+'readelf','-A',str(obj)]),
                core=facts['core'],fpu=facts['fpu'],hard_float='-mfloat-abi=hard' in graph['mcu_flags'],
                assembly=path in graph['asm_sources'])
        elf = root/build/'native.elf'
        NativeArmAttributes_Validate(run([prefix+'readelf','-A',str(elf)]),core=facts['core'],
            fpu=facts['fpu'],hard_float='-mfloat-abi=hard' in graph['mcu_flags'])
        symbols = run([prefix+'nm','-n',str(elf)])
        if len(re.findall(r'(?m)^[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+T\s+_sbrk$',symbols))!=1:
            raise ValueError('Rejecting heap ABI is not one strong linked owner')
        if re.search(r'(?m)^[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+\w\s+(malloc|calloc|realloc|free|_malloc_r|_calloc_r|_realloc_r|_free_r|pvPortMalloc|vPortFree)$',symbols):
            raise ValueError('Dynamic allocator unexpectedly linked')
        vector = root/build/'native-artifact-vectors.bin'
        run([prefix+'objcopy','--dump-section','.isr_vector='+str(vector),str(elf)])
        NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector.read_bytes(),symbols,receipt['contract']['independent_irq_slots'])
        sections = run([prefix+'objdump','-h',str(elf)])
        allocated = 0
        for item in re.finditer(r'^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+([\da-fA-F]+)\s+([\da-fA-F]+)\s+([\da-fA-F]+).*\n\s*([^\n]+)',sections,re.M):
            name,size,vma,lma,flags=item.groups()
            if 'ALLOC' not in flags or int(size,16)==0:continue
            allocated+=1
            for address in [int(vma,16)]+([int(lma,16)] if 'LOAD' in flags else []):
                if not any(region['origin']<=address and address+int(size,16)<=region['origin']+region['length'] for region in facts['regions']):
                    raise ValueError('Native linked section exceeds independently recorded memory: '+name)
        if allocated==0:raise ValueError('No allocated ARM sections parsed')
        map_text=(root/build/'native.map').read_text()
        libraries=NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect(map_text, facts['regions'])
        stack_files=sorted((root/build).rglob('*.su'))
        reports.append({'build':build,'elf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(elf.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'linked_libraries':libraries,
            'stack_usage_files':len(stack_files),
            'dynamic_frames':[str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in stack_files if '\tdynamic' in p.read_text()],
            'limits':'NOT PROVEN: library/indirect call graph, whole-program task/MSP/ISR nesting stack and MCU WCET'})
    (root/'build/native-artifact-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
    print('PASS current artifact hashes, real object/ELF ARM attributes, independent IRQ positions, rejecting heap ABI and physical region bounds')
    print('EP0/full async lifecycle, semantic critical-contract review, actual stack margin, MCU timing and hardware: NOT PROVEN')
